intro: Here Consum projects are linked to Sarjele sheets and elements to blocks. Files are only read and stay unchanged until a write runs.
needFiles: First set the Consum, Sarjele and Probe files on the Storage tab.

projects.title: Projects
projects.hint: A project's consumption is written to its Sarjele sheet. The sheet is locked: open the lock to choose it by hand. Click a name for other spellings in Consum, ID letters, on/off.
projects.empty: No projects yet: they appear once the app reads Consum. You can also add a project by hand.
projects.unlock: Open the lock: choose the sheet for “{{name}}” by hand
projects.willCreate: the sheet will be created on write
projects.sheetMissing: no such sheet — rows are skipped
projects.createOn: On write the sheet appears in Sarjele, styled like the existing ones
projects.createOff: The project's rows are skipped while there is no sheet
projects.aliasHint: Case, symbols and year do not matter: Petra, PETRA_2025 and “Petra 2026” are recognised as one project.

elements.title: Elements and blocks
elements.hint: An element is linked to its block by ID (the app writes it to Consum and next to the block in Sarjele). If names differ or a block is shared, choose the block by hand: the link is remembered.
elements.allLinked: Everything is linked — nothing to do by hand.
elements.orphans: Blocks without elements in Consum ({{n}}): {{list}} — the app leaves them alone.
elements.knownByRegistry: {{id}} → block “{{title}}” · ID will be written to Consum
elements.willCreate: {{id}} · no block — it will be created
